canonical_title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents
description: Researchers introduced AgentSpec, a speculative decoding method for batch inference of LLM agents. The approach addresses speed degradation issues seen in existing speculative decoding techniques when handling large batch sizes, which previously limited real-world deployment of LLM agents. The paper describes a systematization of the technique to maintain generation quality while improving inference efficiency.

canonical_title: LLM Agents Perform Controlled Experiments Using Simulation Models
description: Researchers developed a multi-agent framework allowing LLMs to perform controlled experiments using simulation models. This addresses the need for LLMs to understand system responses to interventions, which is critical for scientific and engineering tasks beyond text/code generation.

canonical_title: Giga-Embeddings: Mixture-of-Experts Encoders for High-Throughput Text Embeddings
description: A new text embedding model called Giga-Embeddings introduces a sparse 1.8B active parameters per token Mixture-of-Experts encoder with 10B total parameters. It achieves top performance across English, Russian, multilingual, and code benchmarks using MTEB evaluation suites.

canonical_title: Agentic observability with Amazon OpenSearch Service MCP Apps
